senses.gloss: (v. Schr. KAT2, p. 380) Tishri, the seventh month of the Jewish calendar, containing thirty days, varying between the fifth of September and the third of November.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:1">R. Hash. I, 1</cite> <he>באחד בת׳ וכ׳</he> the first of Tishri is the era for years, for Sabbatical years, for jubilees &c.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 10b:10">Ib. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>בת׳ נברא העולם</he> the world was created in Tishri; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite>; a. fr.
